description: This file defines the LocalizationAPI class, a RESTful API endpoint in a PHP application that provides read and update access to localization settings such as language and date format within an HRM system. The class utilizes traits for configuration and localization services, and it handles HTTP GET and PUT requests with specific validation rules.

classes.name: LocalizationAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing localization settings such as language and date format within the HRM system.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update request, ensuring submitted language and dateFormat are supported.
